description: InterSim is developed by Tsinghua MARS Lab and collaborators for closed-loop tests of vehicle planners on recorded road scenes. It predicts relationships between drivers to change their responses when new conflicts arise. Inputs are Waymo Open Motion or nuPlan scenarios, road maps and planner settings; outputs include simulation logs, JSON summaries and playback files viewed through a local dashboard. Spatial coverage and time horizon follow the chosen dataset scenarios. Python source is free under MIT, with installation and custom-planner tutorials. A limitation is that the default relation predictor was trained on Waymo and is documented as unsuitable for nuPlan; disabling it can cause yielding deadlocks. InterSim Beta also requires gym 0.18.3 because later interfaces are incompatible. The tool supports road-agent and safety simulations. Waymax (platform-waymax) is a related environment. No dataset registration, model download or simulator execution was performed.
